name: Max India Ltd
about: Max India is the holding company of Max Group’s Senior Care business Antara, an integrated service provider for all senior care needs. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Max India Limited, through its Antara brand and subsidiaries like Max Estates Gurgaon Limited (MEGL), operates in the senior care sector. Their business includes senior living residences, assisted care services such as care homes and at-home care, and a products vertical (AGEasy) catering to senior needs
